protocols.name: CIFAR-100 Random Initialization Scratch Benchmark
protocols.training_regime: From scratch (random initialization, 100 epochs, AdamW, Cosine Annealing)
protocols.controlled_variables: Parameter count strictly matched at ~960,000 weights
protocols.incomparability_notes: Cannot be directly compared on raw accuracy against pretrained models or models evaluated on CIFAR-10 (10 classes) or ImageNet-1K (1000 classes).

protocols.name: CIFAR-10-C Systematic Corruption Robustness Study
protocols.training_regime: Pretrained on large source datasets (ImageNet-1K / ImageNet-21K), fine-tuned for CIFAR-10
protocols.incomparability_notes: Models share the exact same 19 corruptions and 5 severities with identical 224x224 resizing. Directly comparable to each other. Cannot be numerically equated with scratch CIFAR-100 models.

protocols.name: ImageNet-1K Native Classification Benchmark
protocols.training_regime: Supervised training on full ImageNet-1K (1.28M images, 300 epochs)
protocols.incomparability_notes: Evaluated on ImageNet-1K validation set (50,000 images, 1000 classes). Represents high-capacity representation learning. Corruption robustness on CIFAR-10-C was not directly run in this repository.

protocols.name: Hendrycks ImageNet-C Corruption Benchmark
protocols.incomparability_notes: Uses AlexNet error normalization to calculate mCE. Directly informs the taxonomy and weighting of corruptions.
